summary.text: Timothy Soucy is a Democratic state representative from Merrimack District 21 who has served since December 7, 2022, and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026, after advancing from the September 8, 2026 primary. Ballotpedia lists his career experience as firefighter.

paragraphs.text: Ballotpedia lists Soucy on the Transportation Committee in the 2009-2010, 2013-2014, 2015 and 2017 sessions.
He was assigned to the Labor, Industrial and Rehabilitative Services Committee from 2019-2020, when he was vice chair, through 2023-2024.
